exposure: Fertility treatments (in-vitro fertilization - IVF, ovulation induction - OI)
cohort: The study included 6254 pregnancies of non-diabetic and diet-controlled GDM women who conceived after fertility treatments and delivered between the years 1996-2016.
finding: Among pregnancies achieved after fertility treatments, diet-controlled GDM was associated with reduced perinatal mortality but higher rates of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and polyhydramnios.
mod_finding: Diet-controlled GDM in pregnancies achieved after fertility treatments was associated with significantly higher rates of cesarean deliveries (40.8% vs. 31.9%).
